deals.headline: Danvila takes control of Levante after capitalising EUR 13.8m of loans
deals.summary: An extraordinary general meeting (96.27% in favour) approved the financial restructuring plan signed by the main financial creditors (Bridge Securitisation S.C.A. and Fasanara Securitisation S.A.) and the capitalisation of EUR 13.8m of Danvila's loans, lifting his holding to about 70% and diluting the Fundació Levante UD Cent Anys to about 15%. Cadena SER reported Danvila cannot sell 50% of the club until 31 December 2034 unless the restructuring creditors are repaid first.

ownership_summary: Levante is controlled by its chief executive (consejero delegado) José Danvila, a Valencian leather-tanning industrialist, through his companies Bizas Capital S.L. / Bizas Trading Company S.L. He became the largest shareholder (37.90%) in July 2024 by converting loans into shares and rose to about 70% on 21 October 2025, when shareholders approved capitalising EUR 13.8m of his loans under the court-supervised restructuring plan; the fans' foundation (Fundació Levante UD Cent Anys), majority owner since 2008-09, was diluted to about 15% and some 10,600 minority shareholders hold the rest. There is no institutional equity holder: institutional money sits in the debt (Edmond de Rothschild, Fasanara, OLB and CVC via LaLiga Impulso), and in October 2026 the club said about fifteen foreign funds had approached it about a minority stake.
